timeoutInvestigation.finding: The prior Grok failures were model-side stalls, not slow Retail Prices API or engine execution. Tool calls completed in roughly 0.3 seconds or less; the final model turn then stalled for more than 200 seconds before the four-minute trial deadline.

timeoutInvestigation.limitation: A successful rerun does not prove that stochastic or service-side model stalls can never recur. No runner retries, relaxed limits, model substitution or timeout waiver was introduced.
